dict.string: Grow Companion can use your approximate location to suggest your state for the home-cultivation rules. The lookup is handled by Apple's geocoding service; the app keeps only a state or locality name, never your coordinates, and nothing is sent to Grow Companion.
Grow Companion uses Face ID to keep your grow records private when the app is locked.
Grow Companion uses Bluetooth to find and receive readings from environmental sensors you pair to a room.
Grow Companion uses the camera to measure the distance from your light fixture to the canopy. Depth data is processed on-device and not saved.
